A '''warlord''' was active in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] several generations before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The warlord's reign was eventually ended by a [[Jhaka Bakarn's squadron|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], led by the renowned starfighter ace [[Jhaka Bakarn]], though Bakarn [[Death/Legends|died]] in the process. The victory earned the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] much glory, and [[Jhaka Bakarn's father|Bakarn's grieving father]] changed their [[Bakarn family|family's]] name from Bakvalen to Bakarn to honor his fallen daughter.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Bakvalen Family}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The warlord was mentioned in the Codex entry for "The Bakvalen Family" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
